# Sell 50.00 USD out of a US dollar bank that holds none, at 1.37.
#
# The bank goes from 0.00 to -50.00 USD: past zero an asset account acts as a
# liability, so the sale consumes no cost basis and opens a liability cost
# basis of 50.00 USD at the 68.50 CAD it records, 1.37 (Q-054). It states no
# cost_basis_split_guid, there being nothing held for it to draw on.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_a_customers_credit_leaves_a_sale_of_the_banks_dollars_where_it_is.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-03-05 * "Sell 50 USD the bank does not hold"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -50.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-68.50"
	Assets:Bank 68.50 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "68.50"
